description: Where and how far the installer looks for the player's game files (core/install/find_games.py). Each entry is {"value": ..., "description": ...}; edit the values by hand, the code reads them.

user_folders.description: The player's own folders searched after the emulators' (names under the home folder; on Windows the real Downloads, Desktop and Documents are searched too, wherever they were moved).

user_depth.description: How many folders down each of those is searched (0: only its own files).

game_folder_depth.description: How many folders down an emulator's game folder is searched when its settings say deep scan (without it, only the folder itself, as the emulator does).

min_bytes.description: Files smaller than this are not opened (a game file is far bigger: the smaller .cia and .app files of other games are skipped, which spares reads on a cold disk).

max_files.description: Game files (by extension) whose header is read in one search; the search stops there.

max_entries.description: Folder entries looked at in one search, files of any kind included; the search stops there.

max_seconds.description: Seconds after which the search stops (a slow or disconnected network drive).
